generic_domain.justification: - The provided list includes 'image classification' and 'probabilistic image classification'.\n- 'Probabilistic Image Classification' is the more general term as it covers methods that might incorporate probability theory, which can include traditional deterministic approaches under certain conditions or approximations. If we choose this domain, it inherently encompasses both categories: deterministic image classification (when probabilities are 0 or 1) and probabilistic classifications.\n- 'Image Classification' is a subset of 'Probabilistic Image Classification'. While it's an established field on its own, in this context, 'Probabilistic Image Classification' is more comprehensive. By selecting the latter, we cover all possibilities within image classification, whether they use probabilities or not.
